procedure: Build the private shim-on producer against code e394ae68748717c98f20799aea2b4b3e55796afd (runtime identical to main 1c810c5035c3bafb6543916ff06cb70ef6f340ab). Import the same synthetic caller EEPROM, MP and Nunchuk blocks used in W9. Create one virtual HID, verify UHID ancestry, association, HID identity and raw linkage, absence of foreign holders, initial wiimote binding and available sysfs attributes. Supply exact-device guarded rebind and restore scripts locally to the owner. Owner alone runs root steps; on generic bind error, restore original driver immediately. Independently verify restored binding and companion nodes, then close idempotently and verify cleanup. Do not launch either Dolphin arm without a successful generic binding. No global parameter, blacklist, persistent rule, driver/module removal or model change.
semantic_outcome: On Linux 6.12.113+deb13-arm64, an exact-owned original virtual Wii HID initially bound to wiimote has no driver_override attribute. Anders attempted only its per-device wiimote unbind and explicit hid-generic bind; the bind write returned No such device. The guarded script restored wiimote, and the agent independently verified the driver link, exact identity and five input companions before idempotent close and HID/raw/LED removal. Both native Dolphin 2503 arms were not run: no hid-generic binding was established. F6, MP A40020/32, child A40040/16, decoded motion and non-Dolphin A400F0=55 are unmeasured in W9e. The expected absence of kernel evdev, MotionPlus and xwiimote access under hid-generic is also unmeasured.
